newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemig started as buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said is has initiated coverage of Brazilian state-owned power firm Cemig with a buy rating.
-- The Dutch investment bank cited the firm's position as Brazil's third-largest power generator and second-largest distributor of electricity, serving Minas Gerais state.

-- "We view the company as uniquely positioned to prosper in Brazil's emerging wholesale market for electric power, due to its strategic location, strong operating record and untapped hydropower potential," the bank said in a report.
-- ING Barings said it expects the upcoming sale of a 33-percent block of voting shares to a strategic foreign operator will boost its share's price.
-- The sale will result in "more active cost-cutting efforts and more aggressive positioning for competition in the Brazilian wholesale electricity market," the bank said.
-- ING Barings said Cemig shares are currentlky undervalued on both a cash-flow and asset basis.
-- Cemig preferred was flat at Tuesday's close of 33.40 reais while its voting share, which closed at 45.50 reais, was untraded at 1124 local/0824 EDT.
